newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle sales slow at $65 in Kansas-trade.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle sales slow at $65 in Kansas-trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets near midday Monday were slow, with a "handful" of cattle sold in Kansas at $65.00 per cwt, down $1.00 from the bulk of last week's trade at $66.00, feedlot sources said. USDA reported a modest number of cattle sold last week at $67.00.
About 200 head sold Monday at $65.00, but the sales were too light for an adequate market test, the sources said.
"I don't know if this will set the market for the week, " one Kansas feedlot source said.
